headlines.description: — Cole Caufield and Alexandre Texier scored in the shootout after Nick Suzuki’s late tying goal as the Montreal Canadiens beat the Florida Panthers 4-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caufield and Texier score in shootout as Canadiens beat Panthers 4-3

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Ottawa Senators

headlines.description: — Jake Sanderson scored a pair of goals and the Ottawa Senators were closer to a playoff appearance with a 6-2 win over the Tampa Bay Lightning on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sanderson scores twice for Senators in 6-2 win over Lightning

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Zach Werenski scored in the shootout to lead the Columbus Blue Jackets over the Detroit Red Wings 4-3 on Tuesday night, ending a six-game skid.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zach Werenski scores in shootout to lead Blue Jackets over Red Wings 4-3

events.name: Philadelphia Flyers at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Trevor Zegras and Tyson Foerster each scored twice, Dan Vladar made 23 saves and the Philadelphia Flyers routed the New Jersey Devils 5-1 on Tuesday to bolster their playoff position with four games remaining.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zegras and Foerster each score twice as Flyers down Devils 5-1

headlines.description: — Jaccob Slavin scored at 1:13 of overtime as the Carolina Hurricanes beat the Boston Bruins 6-5 on Tuesday night and claimed their fourth Metropolitan Division title in six years.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hurricanes overcome Geekie's hat trick, top Bruins in OT to claim the Metropolitan Division title

events.name: Colorado Avalanche at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Valeri Nichushkin scored twice and Colorado Avalanche beat the St. Louis Blues 3-1 on Tuesday night to clinch the Central Division and the top seed in the Western Conference.
headlines.shortLinkText: Avalanche beat the Blues 3-1 to clinch Central Division and top seed in the Western Conference

headlines.description: — Wyatt Johnston scored twice, including in overtime, to lead the Dallas Stars to the 4-3 win over the Calgary Flames on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Johnston scores in OT in Stars comeback win over the Flames 4-3

headlines.description: — Vladimir Tarasenko scored the go-ahead goal in the second period, Matt Boldy had a goal and an assist, and the Minnesota Wild twice benefited from replay reviews Tuesday night in a 5-2 victory over the skidding Seattle Kraken.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wild beat skidding Kraken 5-2 for 4th straight win, setting up showdown with Stars

headlines.description: — Clayton Keller scored on a power play 33 seconds into overtime to lift the Utah Mammoth to a 6-5 victory over the Edmonton Oilers on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Keller scores on a power play 33 seconds into OT as the Mammoth beat the Oilers 6-5

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Vancouver Canucks

headlines.description: — Cole Smith's goal midway through the third period proved to be the winner as the Vegas Golden Knights held on to beat the Vancouver Canucks 2-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Smith's goal midway through the 3rd period helps the Golden Knights beat the Canucks 2-1

headlines.description: — Justus Annunen stopped 43 shots — one shy of his career high — for his third career shutout, and the Nashville Predators sent the Anaheim Ducks to their sixth consecutive loss, 5-0 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Justus Annunen stops 43 shots for 3rd career shutout in Predators' 5-0 win over Ducks
